scope: Shared Bend Button, actual toolbar, controls example and required tests only; no sidebar or daily Usage changes.

adoption.documentation_overlay: Component README count wording only; no application input changed.

build.compiler: Pinned Bend2.0.37 original CLI/main, Bun1.4.2 minimal GC512 preload; LLVM23.1.4 -O1, SDK27, target26
build.scope: Maintained compiler setup in a bound runner; not literal scripts/build invocation. Empty diagnostics, exact inputs/pins and no owned process groups. Build time is not app performance.

test_scope: Focused component gates with exact inputs/tools/artifacts and empty native diagnostics. Four paint expectations changed for proportional labels, surfaces and Next inset; action/bounds assertions remain intact. No global suite or new proof pass.

native_usage.observed: Rounded border, preserved underlay and labels accepted with no new clipping; toolbar remains dense. Filter/capture/Back and source-loss restart passed. Fourth capture imported after restart; no second restart claimed.

component_contract: Pure bounded painter joins label, caller-supplied style and existing half-open descriptor. App keeps seven rectangles/action IDs and owns dispatch, selection and focus lifecycle. Rounded cutouts preserve actual underlay; full rectangular corner hits are deliberate.
limits: App toolbar keyboard focus is not added; example focus behavior remains separate.
Hover/pressed states, accessibility, resize and shaping/IME are outside this slice.
Earlier206 Usage/Close/PNG and append results retain their own bindings; no fresh207 Close or performance claim.
community: Documented extraction prototype used by app/example. No new first-party license, separate package or repository is published.
publication_safety: Synthetic metadata and hashes only; no private histories, screenshots, databases or host paths.
